overview: The Medford Arts Council hosted introductions for prospective members, discussed the upcoming autumn grant cycle, received a presentation on city economic development initiatives, and debated a research proposal for a Tufts University student field project.

items.title: Welcome and Introductions
items.summary: Co-chair Laura Jasinski welcomed attendees and led introductions among current council members, city staff, and residents interested in joining the council.

items.title: Overview of Grant Cycle and Council Processes
items.summary: Council members reviewed the timeline for the upcoming autumn grant cycle opening September 1 and explained the application review rubric and criteria for becoming a voting member.

items.title: City Economic Development Initiatives and Artist Spaces
items.summary: Economic Development Planner Kayla Miros presented on city programs for local entrepreneurs, prompting a discussion on collaborating with property owners to secure vacant storefronts for temporary galleries and performance spaces.

items.title: Tufts University Graduate Student Field Project
items.summary: Laura Jasinski introduced a proposal to enlist a Tufts University urban planning graduate student team to research cultural planning, public-private partnerships, and transient space solutions in Medford.
